errors.evidence: The description states the green 'Validation' line starts at 1.50, but the plot shows it starts at a much higher value, approximately 1.72, close to the starting point of the 'Train' line.
The description states the peak of the green 'Validation' line occurs at epoch 10, but the plot clearly shows the peak is at epoch 11.
The description states the blue 'Train' line ends at a loss of 0.55 at epoch 30. However, the final data point is at epoch 29 with a loss value of approximately 0.50.
The description states the green 'Validation' line ends at epoch 30, but the last data point shown on the plot is at epoch 29.
